## summary stats
###mean RI by year

```{r}
load(here("data/outputs/grids_usdm_stats.rda"))

grids <- grids %>% filter(!is.na(cpc_index_2010_625)) %>% filter(!(is.na(DM_median_2010_625)))


```


## heatmap DM = 4

```{r}


# Step 1: Long format
dm_long <- grids %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(starts_with("DM_median_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "dm_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "DM_median_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dm_value)) %>%
  mutate(high_dm = dm_value >= 4)

# Step 2: Summarize by year × interval
heatmap_data <- dm_long %>%
  group_by(year, interval) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_high_dm = mean(high_dm) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Add readable interval labels
interval_labels <- tibble(
  interval = 625:635,
  label = paste0(
    month.abb[interval_start_months[as.character(625:635)]],
    "-",
    month.abb[interval_end_months[as.character(625:635)]]
  )
)

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  left_join(interval_labels, by = "interval") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = interval_labels$label))  # Preserve order


#-----------------------------
# Step 4: Plot heatmap with 0% in white
#-----------------------------
#-----------------------------
# Determine max value for color scaling
#-----------------------------
max_val <- max(heatmap_data$pct_high_dm, na.rm = TRUE)

# Small epsilon above 0 to allow white for 0
eps <- 0.0001

#-----------------------------
# Highlight boxes
#-----------------------------
# Map interval numbers to factor positions (1-indexed based on interval_labels order)
interval_levels <- levels(heatmap_data$label)
year_levels <- levels(factor(heatmap_data$year))

get_x <- function(interval_num) which(interval_levels == interval_labels$label[interval_labels$interval == interval_num])
get_y <- function(yr) which(year_levels == as.character(yr))

highlights <- bind_rows(
  # 2011: intervals 629-635
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(629) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(635) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2011) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2011) + 0.5
  ),
  # 2020 interval 635 through 2021 interval 631
  # Split into two rectangles: rest of 2020 and start of 2021
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(635) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(635) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2020) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2020) + 0.5
  ),
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(625) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(633) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2021) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2021) + 0.5
  )
)

highlight_labels <- tibble(
  x     = c(mean(c(get_x(625), get_x(633))),  # 2021 box center
             mean(c(get_x(629), get_x(635)))), # 2011 box center
  y     = c(get_y(2021) - 1,                # just below 2021 box
             get_y(2011) - 1),              # just below 2011 box
  label = c("2020-21 Drought",
             "2011 Drought")
)


#-----------------------------
# Plot
#-----------------------------
p_heatmap_dm <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = label, y = factor(year), fill = pct_high_dm)) +
  geom_tile(color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("white", viridis(100, option = "C", direction = -1)),
      values = rescale(c(0, eps, seq(eps, max_val, length.out = 100))),
      limits = c(0, max_val),
      name = "% DM = 4",
      na.value = "grey90",
      breaks = c(0, 10, 20, max_val),
      labels = c("0", "10", "20", paste0(round(max_val), " (max)"))
    ) +
  # Highlight boxes drawn on top
# Outer black border
  geom_rect(
    data = highlights,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 3
  ) +
  # Inner white border
  geom_rect(
    data = highlights,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Interval",
    y = "Year",
    title = "Heatmap of High Drought Frequency (DM = 4)",
    fill = "% High DM"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +  # Add to plot after geom_rect layers:
  geom_text(
    data = highlight_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  )
p_heatmap_dm

png(here("data/outputs/figures/heatmap_DM.png"),
    width = 800,
    height = 600)
plot(p_heatmap_dm)
dev.off()

```

## heatmap RI
```{r}


#-----------------------------
# 1. Long format RI
#-----------------------------
ri_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(starts_with("cpc_index_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "RI"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "cpc_index_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RI)) %>%
  mutate(payout = RI <= 0.90)  # threshold for payout

#-----------------------------
# 2. Summarize by year × interval
#-----------------------------
heatmap_ri <- ri_long %>%
  group_by(year, interval) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_payout = mean(payout) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#-----------------------------
# 3. Add readable interval labels
#-----------------------------
interval_labels <- tibble(
  interval = 625:635,
  label = paste0(
    month.abb[interval_start_months[as.character(625:635)]],
    "-",
    month.abb[interval_end_months[as.character(625:635)]]
  )
)

heatmap_ri <- heatmap_ri %>%
  left_join(interval_labels, by = "interval") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = interval_labels$label))  # preserve order

#-----------------------------
# 4. Determine min/max for color scaling
#-----------------------------
min_val <- min(heatmap_ri$pct_payout, na.rm = TRUE)
max_val <- max(heatmap_ri$pct_payout, na.rm = TRUE)

#-----------------------------
# 5. Plot RI heatmap
#-----------------------------

highlights <- bind_rows(
  # 2011: intervals 629-635
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(629) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(635) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2011) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2011) + 0.5
  ),
  # 2020 interval 635 through 2021 interval 631
  # Split into two rectangles: rest of 2020 and start of 2021
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(635) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(635) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2020) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2020) + 0.5
  ),
  tibble(
    xmin = get_x(625) - 0.5,
    xmax = get_x(633) + 0.5,
    ymin = get_y(2021) - 0.5,
    ymax = get_y(2021) + 0.5
  )
)

highlight_labels <- tibble(
  x     = c(mean(c(get_x(625), get_x(633))),  # 2021 box center
             mean(c(get_x(629), get_x(635)))), # 2011 box center
  y     = c(get_y(2021) - 1,                # just below 2021 box
             get_y(2011) - 1),              # just below 2011 box
  label = c("2020-21 Drought",
             "2011 Drought")
)


p_heatmap_ri <- ggplot(heatmap_ri, aes(x = label, y = factor(year), fill = pct_payout)) +
  geom_tile(color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Outer black border
  geom_rect(
    data = highlights,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 3
  ) +
  # Inner white border
  geom_rect(
    data = highlights,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +  # Add to plot after geom_rect layers:
  geom_text(
    data = highlight_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "% Payout (RI ≤ 0.90)",
    option = "C",
    direction = -1,
    limits = c(min_val, max_val),
    breaks = c(min_val, 25, 50, 75, max_val),
    labels = c(paste0(round(min_val), " (min)"), "25", "50", "75", paste0(round(max_val), " (max)"))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Interval",
    y = "Year",
    title = "Heatmap of Payout Frequency (RI ≤ 0.90)",
    fill = "% Payout"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_heatmap_ri
#-----------------------------
# 6. Export PNG
#-----------------------------
png(here("data/outputs/figures/heatmap_RI.png"),
    width = 800,
    height = 600)

plot(p_heatmap_ri)
dev.off()


```
